findings: All seven marked links across paragraph, heading, quote, bullet, task, cell and self-reference retain content through native save and exact Undo.
Hover cards show the correct title and excerpt within the viewport; cyclic/self navigation reaches the expected content.
Narrow 760px capture wraps the heading and retains accessible controls without horizontal overflow.
Reload and clean restart retain the expected content; startup/loading and viewport padding remain visible.
limits: Disposable isolated profile; no provider turn or real-library activation.
Two-fps samples are not every raw video frame. Raw videos and dedicated hover stills are retained.
Clean restart and child-process interruption do not prove database power-loss durability.
